component.name: Apache Answer
component.description: Question-and-answer platform software. The security model page establishes what the project considers in scope and out of scope: the trust placed in admin users, the role of CAPTCHA as an anti-abuse measure, and the scope limitation to official plugins.

externalReferences.comment: Source security model document; this file is a structured translation of it.

threats.name: Abuse of admin interfaces by administrators
threats.description: Admin users have full system permissions, which includes access to potentially vulnerable operations. The model assumes administrators act in good faith and will not attack their own systems; security issues within admin interfaces are generally not considered vulnerabilities.

threats.name: Unprivileged users exceeding their authorized capabilities
threats.description: Issues in admin interfaces are considered vulnerabilities when they allow unprivileged users to exceed their authorized capabilities, in contrast to issues only exercisable by trusted administrators.

threats.name: Automated attacks and brute-force password attacks when CAPTCHA is disabled
threats.description: CAPTCHA is an essential security measure to prevent automated attacks and abuse. Disabling CAPTCHA protection could enable attackers to conduct brute-force password attacks; Apache Answer explicitly disclaims responsibility for security problems arising from disabled CAPTCHA protection.

threats.name: Vulnerabilities in custom or third-party plugins
threats.description: Apache Answer only guarantees security for official plugins from the approved repository. Third-party plugins fall outside the security model's scope, and the project assumes no responsibility for vulnerabilities in custom or external plugins.

controls.name: Keep CAPTCHA protection enabled
controls.description: CAPTCHA serves as an essential security measure to prevent automated attacks and abuse, including brute-force password attacks. Operators should not disable it; the project disclaims responsibility for problems arising from disabled CAPTCHA.

controls.name: Use only official plugins from the approved repository
controls.description: Security is only guaranteed for official plugins from the project's approved repository; custom or external plugins are outside the security model.
